claims.quote: Hoplisoma loxozonum, long known as Corydoras loxozonus, is an armoured catfish from the Rio Meta basin in Colombia, also referred to by its C-number, C082.

regions.name: Rio Orinoco
regions.quote: C. loxozonus originates from the Rio Orinoco and its affluents.
